name: DANCO
recent: DANCO 最近在 2026 年 9 月有多项董事及大股东持股变动的申报，涉及董事 Aik Swee Tong 与 Aik Cwo Shing 通过 ABC Equity Sdn Bhd 间接增持股份。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 董事 Aik Swee Tong 与 Aik Cwo Shing 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日通过 ABC Equity Sdn Bhd 间接增持公司股份。

recent_en: DANCO recently saw several filings in September 2026 on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, involving indirect acquisitions by directors Aik Swee Tong and Aik Cwo Shing through ABC Equity Sdn Bhd. The company will release its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026. There was no recent news coverage.
